definitions.percentile_ci95: [q2.5, q97.5] of the B replicates (nanpercentile), as bootstrap_ci.py
definitions.bca_ci95: BCa: z0 = Phi^-1(fraction of replicates < point); a = sum(d^3)/(6 sum(d^2)^1.5), d = mean(jack) - jack_i, leave-one-image-out jackknife of the same statistic; endpoints at Phi(z0 + (z0+z)/(1 - a (z0+z))), z = +-1.96
definitions.role: in_domain = run on its own source test split (dfiredd/dfiresub runs are labelled 'cross' in matrix_summary.json but are in-domain by this definition); core_cross = six seed-3407 core runs x two labelled cross targets
